decisions.basis: MUXOUT may drive 3.3 V (LEV_SEL default) into 1.8 V MCU pin before firmware sets LEV_SEL; current limit. Design choice

decisions.decision: Single-ended 10 MHz on REFP (ac-coupled), REFN ac-coupled to GND; PFD 10 MHz integer-N (N=660 for 6.6 GHz)
decisions.basis: ADF4371 Rev 0 p10, p19 (SE 10-500 MHz). Cap value 100 nF is a design choice

decisions.decision: RF8P/N: 7.5 nH pull-up to VCC_X1 rail, 10 pF ac coupling; unused RF8N terminated in 50 ohm
decisions.basis: ADF4371 Rev 0 p21, p24, Fig 44, Table 1

decisions.decision: RFAUX8 routed to an LO monitor SMA (off by default, PDB_AUX = 0)
decisions.basis: ADF4371 Rev 0 REG0072; RFAUX8 treated like RF8 (p9)

decisions.decision: RF16x / RF32x left open
decisions.basis: ADF4371 Rev 0 pin table: 'If unused, this pin can be left open'

decisions.decision: 3 dB pi attenuator (294/17.4/294 ohm) after LO buffer to keep LTC5553 LO in -6..+6 dBm and below +10 dBm abs max
decisions.basis: computed (see reports/H2A_LO_BUDGET.csv)

decisions.decision: One 21 dB coupler per chain between converter and ADAR1000 RF_IO; coupled ports combined by EP4RKU+ to one CAL SMA. RX cal: tone into CAL appears at coupler INPUT (mixer side) of all 4 chains simultaneously -> measures relative phase of N310+LO+converter paths after every start/retune. TX cal: each chain's forward wave sampled at CAL
decisions.basis: EDC21-24+ REV.A (coupling 21 dB typ 8-10 GHz, directivity 19 dB typ); EP4RKU+ REV.C (phase unbalance 1.9 deg typ, 19 deg max -> must itself be calibrated once)

decisions.decision: 50 ohm termination of the 10 MHz reference input (ADF4371 REFP is high impedance)
decisions.basis: ADF4371 Rev 0 Fig 35 (2.5k/85k input); value is a design choice. Level from shared 10 MHz distribution UNRESOLVED

decisions.decision: PPS received by 74LVC1G125 at 1.8 V (LVC inputs tolerate 3.3/5 V) -> MCU timer capture
decisions.basis: 74LVC1G125 is a KiCad-library part; input tolerance from TI LVC family - verify in TI DS. N310 PPS level UNRESOLVED

decisions.decision: One TPS22810 per chain on the PA drain, enable = PA_DRAIN_EN (hardware AND of MCU_PA_EN, WDT_OK, NEG_OK); EN pulled low -> drain OFF at reset
decisions.basis: ADTR1107 Rev C p24 (gate before drain) + ADAR1000 Rev B p41/p44-45 (PA_BIAS 0 V at power-up). TPS22810 is a KiCad-library part; EN threshold vs 1.8 V logic to verify in TI DS

decisions.decision: 100k pull-down on every enable, load and TDD input -> radio powers up muted (TX off, PA drain off, mixers/PLL off, RX beams not loaded)
decisions.basis: MCU GPIOs are high-Z in reset; ADAR1000 TX_LOAD/RX_LOAD need external pull-down (DS p14)

decisions.decision: TX_ALLOW = MCU_TX_EN & WDT_OK & TX_PERMIT_IN; BF_TR = TDD_TR_IN & TX_ALLOW (to all 4 ADAR1000 TR); TX_ALLOW also drives ADAR1000 PA_ON (forces PA_BIAS OFF when low); PA_DRAIN_EN = MCU_PA_EN & WDT_OK & NEG_OK
decisions.basis: ADAR1000 Rev B p13-14 (TR high = TX; PA_ON low forces OFF bias in TR mode), TR switching 180 ns; ADTR1107 tON 10 ns

decisions.decision: TDD TR from N310 front-panel GPIO (3.3 V) into 1.8 V LVC gate; TX_PERMIT_IN is an external interlock (open = TX inhibited); BF_TR brought out for timing check
decisions.basis: N310 GPIO level/ATR mapping UNRESOLVED (UHD GPIO docs)
